title: How to be a five-star driver at Lagos airport
excerpt: Airport riders are tired, carrying bags and watching the clock. Small habits make the difference.
body:
## Be there before they are

Flight-aware pickups mean you can see updated landing times. Plan to be at the pickup point before the rider clears arrivals.

## Look the part

Clean, smart clothes. Clean shoes. A neat look. Riders see your name and photo before you arrive, so match your photo.

## Say less, help more

Greet by name, take the bags, open the door. Offer a bottle of water. Ask once about the temperature.

## Keep them informed

If the road is slow, say so early and explain your plan. Riders forgive delay when they feel informed.

## Close well

Check they have all their belongings. Thank them. Wish them a safe evening.

## Handle the common problems

- **The flight is late.** Stay at your pickup point and watch the updated time in the app. Message the rider that you are waiting.
- **The rider cannot find you.** Call them, describe where you are and what you are wearing, and share your plate number.
- **The rider has lots of luggage.** Load it carefully, tell them if anything will not fit, and contact Support early rather than at the kerb.
- **Traffic is heavy.** Tell the rider your plan before they ask. Calm updates build trust.

## What riders notice most

Riders rarely remember a perfect trip. They remember the one thing that was wrong: a late driver, a dirty seat, an argument over the fare, a phone call while driving. Get those four right every time and your ratings will follow.

## Read the full orientation

Dress, behaviour, conversation and driving standards are in the [driver orientation](/drivers#orientation).
